rv.q: Under the direction of Laura Alcala Baker, this story is deftly woven together.
Suffice it to say that Loza spins a tale worthy of your time in the theater.
All in all, a smaller play, focusing only on the main characters, would have been a better choice.
As the final production in the BOLD series, "Bull: a love story" fell short.
I think you will truly love the ending.

cn.t: A quiet, character-driven drama about reentry after incarceration earns praise for nuanced performances and realistic dialogue, though some critics find the execution doesn't fully deliver on its poignant premise.
